_comment: Hand-maintained: formats of server-side secrets that have a documented, distinctive prefix, so a match is very unlikely to be anything else. Each pattern's first group is the random part (for Slack, the final section; for a stateless GitHub App token, the JWT signature), which must not look like a placeholder. Keys meant to be public (Stripe pk_live_, Google API keys AIza…) and formats without a prefix (an AWS secret access key) are left out. Only the fact that one was found is reported, never its kind, value or place (SPEC S9).

formats.kind: Stripe live secret, restricted or organization key
GitHub App installation token (stateless format ghs_APPID_JWT)
